1: Now, for those standing in lower doctrines, even up to gurus — immediately after death, solely by the power-descent arisen for raising the dead, let him perform the initiation called the final sacrament; and for those standing in higher doctrines, who have lost their observance and performed no expiation — thus is the Lord's command.
2: Therein, whatever rite was told for raising the dead — all of it is to be done to the body: by the full oblation, the burning of the corpse-body. But for the deluded, to plant conviction, let him perform, with the force of ritual-knowledge-yoga, a trust-bearing funeral rite; therein, on the corpse-body, having placed mantras in the withdrawing order, having drawn them in by the net-sequence, having done curbing-piercing-rubbing and the rest, let him do, by the breath-moving sequence, in heart, throat, forehead — and lo, the corpse-body trembles.
3: Then, having made the joining with the supreme Śiva, let him burn it with the full oblation; for the purified by funeral, and for the others too — or: a three-day śrāddha-initiation: on the fourth day, month by month, year by year, let him perform it.
4: Therein, having performed the rite ending in oblation, having made a food-offering in one hand, having meditated on his power of virile form, knowable-formed, that has attained identity with the knowable-power present in the beast — let him offer it to the Lord as enjoyer. Thus, when knowable-being ceases, he becomes the Lord himself. Whether by funeral-raising-śrāddha-initiations one has succeeded or not, still, for one desiring enjoyment, multitude of rites for multitude of fruit — thus, let him perform all.
5: Even of the liberation-seeker, for the attainment of made-of-That-ness, this — of the living, daily, like sustained practice.
6: But for the knower of reality, no rite here ending in funeral and śrāddha is of any use: his death is a festival day for those continuing his knowledge-lineage, from the filling of consciousness-portion — of so much lineage, since the sole reality is mere consciousness — like the day of the lineage's attainment of knowledge while living.
